subheadline: Access, licensing and billing, answered by the people who handle those mailboxes. Anything not covered here reaches the subscriptions desk in Vienna, which replies within two working days.

items.question: What does a Reader plan include?
items.answer: EUR 12 per month gives one person full-text access to all 9,800 papers in the archive, saved searches, and the Signal Weekly briefing. Downloads are unlimited and stay yours if you cancel.

items.question: Can my institution buy seats in bulk?
items.answer: Institutional access is EUR 6,400 per year for 250 concurrent seats, authenticated by IP range or single sign-on. Usage reports arrive each quarter in COUNTER 5 format.

items.question: May I reuse a figure in my own teaching?
items.answer: Yes. Everything published under CC BY-NC 4.0 may be reused for non-commercial teaching with attribution. Commercial reuse goes through the rights desk, which answers within five working days.
